text: Planned the single-file build and decomposed it into five steps.
log: architecture: canvas 2D, no dependencies, rAF with a clamped delta and a fixed 1/8s step accumulator. Sections in order: CONST, audio, input, grid/snake, state machine, render, boot. Logical 640x480 canvas scaled by devicePixelRatio, letterboxed on resize. Input on window with preventDefault for arrows and space; listeners attached once at boot, never per restart. One AudioContext, unlocked on the first keydown.

submit.summary: Five steps: scaffold, movement, pellets and scoring, screens and HUD, juice and audio.

steps.name: scaffold
steps.charter: Create output/neon-snake.html with the doctype, the canvas, the CONST object copied verbatim from the design, the resize/DPR sizing, the utils, and a marked placeholder comment for every later step.
steps.done_when: The file exists and the extracted <script> passes `node --check`.

steps.name: movement
steps.charter: Grid, snake body, turning with the arrow/WASD bindings, wrap-around edges, and the fixed-step accumulator that advances it.
steps.done_when: step() advances the head one cell per tick and wraps at all four edges.

steps.name: pellets
steps.charter: Pellet placement off the snake, eating, growth, score, and the speed ramp from 8 to 16 steps/s over 60s.
steps.done_when: Eating a pellet grows the snake by one cell and increments score.

steps.name: screens
steps.charter: The title/playing/paused/gameover state machine, the HUD, and the RESTART button.
steps.done_when: SPACE starts, P pauses and resumes, self-collision reaches game over, and R restarts.

steps.name: juice
steps.charter: Pellet pop particles, the 120ms death shake, and the WebAudio blip and death saw, unlocked on first input.
steps.done_when: A pellet spawns 8 particles and plays a blip; death shakes the canvas and plays the saw.
